values.note: The vault toilet is at the Braley Pond day-use area (open sunrise to sunset); no drinking water there.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/braley-pond-day-use-area (Restrooms: 'Vault toilet(s)'; Water: 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; 'Open Year Round Day Use Only: Sunrise to Sunset'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Forest Service dispersed camping: no reservations. 'Dispersed camping in one location is allowable up to 14 days in any 30-day period.' Braley Pond's day-use page: 'No dispersed camping allowed in picnic area.' Keep the campsite within 150 ft of the road and at least 100 ft from water.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/camping-cabins ('Dispersed camping in one location is allowable up to 14 days in any 30-day period') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/braley-pond-day-use-area ('No dispersed camping allowed in picnic area', 'No fees are required for this site'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on the Forest Service's Braley Pond day-use page and the GW&J dispersed-camping rules: vault toilet at the pond (derived -> manual), no potable water, no camping in the picnic area, free, first-come, 14 days in any 30. Fees (free) left as they are. Not stated: number or size of the dispersed sites along FDR 96.
flags: Aggregator link in website: https://tmbtent.com/virginia-free-dispersed-camping/ is a blog listing; the Forest Service page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/braley-pond-day-use-area (and the forest's dispersed rules https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/camping-cabins).
